> [!WARNING]
> Still a work in progress: expect graphical, animation and sound bugs.
>
> The game has been tested from saves all through it, but a full playthrough from the very start to the end has not been done yet. **Issue reports are very welcome**, whatever you find.

Version 0.2.0 with one addition, **James bends down for what he picks up**; everything new since the alphas is listed here again. It is mostly about making the game play like the original. Enemies, combat and many events were compared with the original game running side by side, thanks to [sh2-nx](https://github.com/cutarev/sh2-nx).

**Updating from 0.2.0 or an alpha:** install the new VPK over the old one. The game data does not need to be converted again.

### New in 0.2.1

- **Picking up:** James bends down for things on the floor, stays down while the message shows and stands up again, as in the original. He does so for notes and other things he looks at on the floor, too.

### Getting stuck

- **Labyrinth lift:** it goes down now, and the way out at the bottom is there (#7, #8).
- **Elevators:** the doors open on their own side, the hotel's employee elevator moves, and the elevator panels have the original's cursor over the buttons (#7).
- **Battery room:** the flashlight dies with its battery, and the map can be read afterwards (#8).
- **Pickups:** the bullets in the apartments' safe and in the hospital can be taken once they are open (#8).
- **Pyramid Head** walks out of the flooded stairwell instead of getting stuck (#8).
- **Courtyard pool:** James drops into it, with his fall animation (#8).

### Enemies and combat (#9)

- The action level reaches the enemies and James' health. Every game played as Normal before; Easy and Beginner now give James 200 health.
- Lying Figures, Mannequins, Nurses, Mandarins, Creepers and Pyramid Head follow the original's rules for reach, timing and behaviour. The Mandarin no longer holds James for ever.
- Creepers can be stomped on the move, lie on the floor before dying, and call the others.
- After being hurt James gets a moment before the next attack starts.
- The weapon comes up while walking or running, heavy swings step in, and combos have their window.
- Hits move James by his own animations, and at no health it is the next blow that kills.
- Guard, with Aim and Run held, takes most of the damage.

### Controls

- The layout is the one of [sh3-vita](https://github.com/AngeloGalav/sh3-vita): see the [README](https://github.com/AngeloGalav/sh2-vita#controls).
- Changed buttons are kept after a restart (#4). If they look wrong after updating, use *Options*, *Controls*, *Buttons*, *Defaults*.

### Sound and picture

- The music's crackle: the volume was turned down in sudden steps in loud music. Now it goes down smoothly.
- The clock in room 208 stops ticking, and the labyrinth lift plays at full volume (#5).
- The red light behind the apartments' bars is there only with Pyramid Head (#5).
- The save screen's picture has its right proportions.
- Puzzle texts are at the bottom, in the game's own font.
- The hotel's video tape scene: the armchair faces the television, and televisions show static.
- James turns his head to items and people, and reacts to the screams in the apartments and the labyrinth.
- Maria stays in sight in the hospital's elevator.

### Known problems

- Fog can be drawn inside places where it belongs outside, such as the hotel's room 312 and the parking lot's first scene.
- The companion Maria's shadow is a little corrupted.

If the game freezes, attach `stall.txt` from `ux0:data/sh2-vita/` to the report, with the version shown on the title screen. What is open is listed in [STATUS.md](https://github.com/AngeloGalav/sh2-vita/blob/main/port/STATUS.md).
